audience: print-on-demand sellers who sell designed products and ship orders through Spreadconnect

useCases.title: Check the status and tracking of an order
useCases.text: Read an order by its Spreadconnect id to see its state and items. Then list its shipments with the carrier and tracking numbers.

useCases.title: Find sizes that are out of stock
useCases.text: List your articles with their skus, sizes and colours. Then read the stock of those skus to find the sizes that are sold out.

useCases.title: Place an order and confirm it for production
useCases.text: Create an unconfirmed order from article skus and a delivery address. Choose a shipping type, then confirm the order only when you approve it, because confirming starts production and bills your account.

useCases.title: Cancel an order before production starts
useCases.text: Read an order to check its state. Cancel it if production has not started, because a cancelled order cannot be reopened.

useCases.title: Create a product from a design and a blank catalog item
useCases.text: Read a blank product type with its colours and sizes. Upload a design from a public image URL, then create an article that places it on the product.
